en: H-How'd I do!?
You may not want to do that in public...

What!? Was it that bad...?
Do I need more practice?

Amazing...!
It's like I'm talking to a real horse.
Was it that good?

To be honest, I thought it still needed a lot
of work, but I'm feeling more confident now.

Huh? Something interesting?
Let me think...

Oh, this morning as I was brushing my teeth,
I realized my mouth was foaming up with bubbles.
And when I say bubbles, I mean <font_kind=yakuza_italic>bubbles</font_kind>!

But then when I looked at my toothpaste, I realized
I'd grabbed the face cleanser! How funny is that?
That's good.

Right? <symbol=note_with_outline>
I couldn't help but laugh.

No, that's not funny at all.
It could have been toxic...

Huh? Maybe you and I have
different ideas of humor, Kiryu-san...

I guess I'd say I have not too many,
but not too few.

When I first got here, I had a tough time making
friends but going to anime and game events really helped.

Now I have tons of friends,
and we all share the same hobbies.

Nice.
That's great.

Yeah, I'm really thankful to anime and games.
They even helped me make friends.

Yeah, I totally play games. My favorites
are the ones where you raise cute monsters.

Oh, and I've recently gotten into these romance
games aimed at men where you woo cute girls.

Oh yeah? Wouldn't it be rare for a girl
to play romance games for men?

How should I put this? I thought maybe it'd give
me some insight into how men approach romance.
But wouldn't that be a pretty bad reference?

Huh? Really?
Hmm, so games won't work, either...
Romance games are probably the best reference.
I knew these games would come in handy... <symbol=note_with_outline>

Yeah. Those games are made with guys in mind.
Could be more useful than some real life flings.

I see...!
Kiryu-san, do you play those games too?
Maybe, maybe not.

As long as we're here,
you should woo me, too.

Huh? I-I couldn't...
Out of the blue... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

W-Well... after I finish the other three routes
and I've learned the secret... Maybe I will... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Huh? What is it?
Now I'm curious.
Actually, I...
I used to be a taxi driver.

Really? I wouldn't have expected that!
You should take me on a drive sometime!
I'm from Taiwan.
[Huh? Really?]
Huh? Wh-What...?

You didn't catch a word of that!
Lies will catch up to you, you know?
I'm broke right now...

What!? D-Does that mean...
You can't pay your bill...?

This is bad... H-Hold on.
I'll go get some money from my purse.

No, uh... Sorry.
I was joking.
Huh...? A joke?

Whew. That's a relief...
I'm glad you're not broke, Kiryu-san.
You're so gullible... Sorry.

Hm... I feel kind of uncomfortable
around people with them. They can be scary.

I can drink, but I'm a lightweight.
I prefer to just sip plum wine.

The Tojo Clan?
Is that some kind of karate dojo or something?

Hmm. I've never heard of her.
Sorry.

Huh? Oh, do tell!
What kind of adventures have you had?
I've actually been shot before.

What!? You mean with real bullets?
You're lucky to be alive, aren't you?
I've fought in an arena before.

An arena?
You mean like those video game tournaments?
No... Well, I guess it is kinda like that.
I'm amazing at karaoke.

Oh? Amazing in what way?
You should take me sometime.
You'll see when you get there.
I'm good at making <font_kind=yakuza_italic>danzai</font_kind> noodles!

<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Danzai</font_kind> noodles?
Kinda like <font_kind=yakuza_italic>dandan</font_kind> noodles?

They're totally different!
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Danzai</font_kind> noodles are a Taiwanese specialty.
They're really light and go down easy.
Huh... That does sound good.

I'm type B. I don't know if it's related,
but people always tell me I'm pretty easygoing.
Geez, what would you even do if I told you?

Nope. I had one until last year,
but we broke up.
That means now's your chance, Kiryu-san!
What? O-Okay...!

I actually had a bit of a complex
about being taller than most women.

Then a friend told me that would work in my favor
as a hostess, so I got into this line of work.

It's working. You have a model's figure and you're 
beautiful too, so you must be the one to beat here.
I'd be lying if I said no... <symbol=note_with_outline>

But thanks to this job, I don't feel nearly as
self-conscious about my height anymore.
Nowadays, I'm glad I decided to become a hostess.

But in that case, wouldn't becoming a pro wrestler
have been a better choice than a hostess?
No... I don't think I'd want to wrestle anyone.
How tall are you?
165 centimeters.

165? Is that even tall? 
Seems pretty short actually...
You're just built like a tree, Kiryu-san!

I was told the average is 155,
so I'm on the taller end.

I see... I never paid much
attention to stuff like that.
Huh? You're the king, Kiryu-san!?

Yeah, I am. And as the king,
you have to do what I say, Sora.
B-By your leave!
Y-You're pretty good at this...

I like a lot of Taiwanese tunes,
but I mostly end up listening to Japanese music.

I just really love anime songs!
You should give them a shot, Kiryu-san.
I'm having fun, too! <symbol=note_with_outline>

It has!
We have to take good care of ourselves!

I'm just happy to be the appetizer
of choice then, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Hey, you shouldn't even joke about that.
A lot of women would take you seriously.
Huh...? What's gotten into you!?

E-Even though I know you're joking,
hearing you say it is still... I... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

K-Keep it down, please!
You'll disturb the other customers...
Yes, [hello]. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I didn't think you were that type of guy...
And here I was just starting to like you, too.
What? Uh, no... I meant...

Thank you.
You're pretty cute yourself.
I'll take the compliment!

Huh...? What?
Could you say that again?
[Oh, thank you.] <symbol=note_with_outline>
[Perfect nose...]
Oh, I think that means "perfect nose"!

I actually like my nose quite a bit,
so, thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>
[Marvelous mouth...]

That's the first time anyone's
ever complimented my mouth. Thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>
No problem. <symbol=note_with_outline>

You don't have to tell me twice.
I want to keep looking at you forever... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Hmm... It's a secret... <symbol=note_with_outline>
Who could say? <symbol=note_with_outline>
Come on, don't be coy now.

No way. <symbol=note_with_outline>
My lips are sealed, Kiryu-san! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Burns hurt, so I don't want that.

Okay, I guess I better get
a bucket of cold water ready.
Everyone will be happy to hear that!
I go to Chinese places a lot.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Those</font_kind> kinds of shops? Specifically?

You might say they're... uh...
places where men go to relax...

Y'know... the women there dress up
as nurses or police officers, and...
Oh! They're cosplaying!?

You meant cosplay restaurants, right!?
In that case, leave it to me!

When it comes to cosplay restaurants,
nobody can show you better ones than me. <symbol=note_with_outline>

You went that wild?
I'm amazed you didn't get arrested!
Everyone makes mistakes now and then.

My grandpa said that what's important is whether
or not you can bear the weight of your actions.

Your grandpa said that?
Actually, that's pretty good.
Yeah. I love my grandpa.

That's so sad... but I'm sure he's up in heaven
just happy that you still think about him.
Honestly, I think it's different for everyone.

Really? I'm surprised. I imagine most babies
would start crying the moment you picked them up.

Wait a sec, that's not very nice.
I'm practically a diaper master now.

You go fishing? That's so manly and cool. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I kind of want to watch you fish, Kiryu-san.

You sound like the protagonist of an anime.
That's so cool! <symbol=note_with_outline>

You do have kind of an aura around you, Kiryu-san.
I'm sure you stand out to those guys.

I'm sure everyone's just jealous
of how handsome you are... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Oh, is that all it is?
Those petty punks.

Oh, I know that! Back in high school,
I used to race against the boys in my class.

Really? No wonder.
Your muscle definition hadn't escaped me. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Then let's take our drinks nice and slow today.
You're like a cute horse grazing in the grass. <symbol=note_with_outline>

If you're an herbivore, then I'll
be the grass... or something to that effect. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I'm the same way, actually.

I was actually a little
nervous when we met, Kiryu-san.
I never noticed.

Wow, that's amazing.
Does that mean you're rich, Kiryu-san?
Hm... About 35?

You're way off!
I'm well past 40.

What!? R-Really?
You don't look it at all.

Um... Do you have any secrets
that keep you looking so young?

No matter how old you are,
never stop loving.

You're a real cheesy romantic... <symbol=note_with_outline>
But, love really is the best. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I can only think of one thing that became a
daily routine, and that's getting into fights.

Huh!? Th-Then, starting tomorrow,
I'm going to<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
H-Hey... Let's not get hasty...

Well, at the end of day,
it all comes back to collagen.

Huh!? Kiryu-san!? You take collagen...?
That's not what I expected.

Huh? You? Let's seeeee...
I think you're a good person.

I think that despite your looks,
you're actually a great guy. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Huh? U-Um...
I think you're really manly... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I like older men.

Most older guys are a little more collected,
and they have a mature sexiness about them... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I didn't say <font_kind=yakuza_italic>you</font_kind> specifically, Kiryu-san.

Although, I guess you would
fall in that category... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

But the older they are,
the older they smell.
What did my dreams ever do to you...?
You're really sexy, too.
Oh, you think so? <symbol=note_with_outline>

This probably isn't a fetish, but seeing someone
chowing down their food gets me a little excited.

Then I can brush a stray grain of rice
off their cheek and... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

What I want the most?
Let's see... Oh, I want a sewing machine.

Huh. Kinda mundane, isn't it?
Why's that?
I want to sew my own cosplays, of course.

So right now I'm keeping an eye for machines
that are easy for beginners.

I get that. I guess it would be more fun to wear
a costume you actually made by yourself.

I think so, too! It's probably going to
be a time sink, but I'm excited to try. <symbol=note_with_outline>

My first love lives on
in my heart to this day! <symbol=heart_with_outline>

His beautiful, straight, silver hair cascades down
to his waist, and his sword is longer than he is.

Sounds like a dangerous guy.
You hang out in those crowds?

Yup. He's the villain of an RPG
I played when I was younger. <symbol=note_with_outline>
What color would you want them to be?
White, I guess...?
Then I'm sure you'd be happy... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Black, I guess...

Oh, too bad. My black ones
are in the laundry right now...
None would be nice...

What? Come on, Kiryu-san.
That's just unsanitary.
I do think I'd like to get married, someday. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Oh, thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>

My skin's nice today,
so I nailed my makeup, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>
What? Hmm... Hmmm... Oh, I know!

There was a guy groping people at the Taiwan
airport this one time... Was that you, Kiryu-san?
Wrong guy...
[Thank you.] <symbol=note_with_outline>

I definitely wouldn't want it to happen to me.
I'd have to break up with a guy I couldn't trust.
So Kiryu-san, you'd better not cheat on me, okay?

Oh, in that case, I recommend going to
a farm or walking around a market. It's fun!

It'd be nice to relax with an
anime or video game together. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Yep, you're right!
I was on the dance team up through high school.
Huh!? I-I wouldn't mind, but...
By the way, Kiryu-san, what team are you on?
What? O-Oh, you mean do I wear boxers or briefs?
Yep. Which is it?
Hmm. I...
I wear boxers.
I see. Some guys wear those I guess.
I wear a fundoshi.

Wow, you're such a traditional Japanese man.
How wonderful... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
All I need is a leaf.

Huh? Isn't that a little too wacky?
I guess it is ecological, but...
I don't think we have miso soup on the menu...
